What Sweetgreen says to expect

  • Full year 2026: guidanceFor fiscal year 2026, we are updating our guidance as follows: • Approximately 10 Net New Restaurant Openings, with about half featuring the Infinite Kitchen • Same-Store Sales Change of about (5.5)% • Restaurant-Level Profit Margin of 11.0% to 11.5% • Adjusted EBITDA between $(23.0) million to $(20.0) million
  • Fiscal year 2027: restaurant openingsWe expect about half as many Net New Restaurant Openings in fiscal year 2027 compared to fiscal year 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
